google-minesweeper.slogan: Clear the board without detonating any mines in Google Minesweeper!
google-minesweeper.description: Looking for a classic puzzle challenge? Google Minesweeper is a perfect choice! This engaging game tests your logic and strategy skills. Enjoy Google Minesweeper online and avoid all the hidden mines. Play Google Minesweeper now and see how far you can get!

HomeIframe.title: Google Minesweeper
HomeIframe.description: Google Minesweeper is an online single-player puzzle game where you clear the board without detonating any mines.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Google Minesweeper is a classic logic puzzle game where you must clear a grid containing hidden mines. Use your reasoning skills to uncover safe squares and flag the mines.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Reveal squares by clicking on them. If you uncover a mine, the game ends.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Right-click (or long-press on mobile) to flag potential mine locations.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Win by revealing all the squares without mines or correctly flagging all the mines.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Intuitive controls and clear graphics make it easy to play Google Minesweeper.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Play Google Minesweeper on desktop and mobile devices.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Start playing instantly by searching "Google Minesweeper" in your browser.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Choose from Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced levels.
